title: Reinforcing What the Student Has Learned: Teacher-Guided On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.07722v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves language-model reasoning through dense teacher feedback on student-generated responses.We first observe an amplitude disparity in this feedback: on math reasoning responses, style-related positions exhibit 3.5 times the mean absolute teacher--student log-probability difference of mathematical positions.Scaling OPD updates by these discrepancies thus directs much of the update strength toward matching the teacher's expression. We instead take the student's own pretrained base as a reference: the student--base difference records the token preferences acquired during post-training and provides supervision that does not depend on the student's distance from the teacher. Building on this reference, we propose Student-Delta On-Policy Distillation (SD-OPD), which uses centered student--base differences as update coefficients, keeps each coefficient only when its sign agrees with centered teacher--student fe

translated_title: 强化学生已学到的知识：教师引导的在策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 在策略蒸馏（OPD）通过教师对学生生成回答的密集反馈来提升语言模型的推理能力。我们首先观察到这种反馈中存在幅度失衡：在数学推理回答上，风格相关位置的平均绝对师生对数概率差是数学相关位置的3.5倍。因此，若以这些差异来缩放OPD更新，将使大部分更新强度被用于模仿教师的表达方式。我们转而以学生自身的预训练基础模型作为参照：学生与基础模型之间的差异记录了后训练阶段习得的词元偏好，从而提供了一种不依赖于学生与教师之间距离的监督信号。基于该参照，我们提出学生增量在策略蒸馏（SD-OPD），该方法以中心化的学生-基础模型差异作为更新系数，且仅当系数符号与中心化的师生（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出SD-OPD方法，以学生自身预训练基础模型的差异作为更新权重，避免在策略蒸馏被师生表达风格差异主导，从而强化学生已习得的推理能力。
en_tdlr: SD-OPD uses the student's own pretrained base as a reference to weight on-policy distillation updates, preventing style-related teacher-student discrepancies from dominating and instead reinforcing what the student has already learned.
